title: Cutting the defense budget: How allocation costs shape induced resistance in plants
content:
by Ethan Bass

Plants have limited resources for defense. A new study in PLOS Biology reveals how plants limit costs through a tiered defense system, deploying cheap traits immediately, while delaying spending on costly ones until a critical damage threshold is reached.
